_description: GlazeBid AiQ System Knowledge Base — trade knowledge that classification depends on. Authored/verified by Martin (master estimator). Vision detects; THIS classifies; rules bound scope. Extend freely — every entry here fixes a class of AI error permanently.

scope_color_convention._note: Martin's Bluebeam tool-chest colors, confirmed 2026-07-15. RGB 0-1.

manufacturer_systems._note: series → system class. THE decisive signal for SF vs CW — never classify from panel size or appearance when a series code is present. The SPEC decides which manufacturers are approved on a job (basis of design + approved equals) — this table classifies whatever series appears; it never restricts. Growing list; add every series encountered.

scope_boundary_rules.rule: Overhead doors are ALWAYS excluded — sectional, rolling, coiling, high-speed spiral — including any glass or polycarbonate lites in them (glazed by door supplier).
Glass/vision lites in hollow metal doors and hollow metal frames = Glazing Only scope (glazier furnishes glass, not frames).
scope_boundary_rules.source: McLarty + Hope blind tests vs Martin markups

scope_boundary_rules.rule: Hardware items 'provided by aluminum storefront provider' in hardware sets/schedules are bid scope — highlight and carry into pricing.
Scope-relevant general notes (e.g. 'at curtainwall frames provide internal reinforcing...') must be flagged and attached to the affected system.
Louvered hollow metal doors with no glass = not glazing scope.
Glass film (GF- marks) called out on frames = glazing scope line item; cross-reference finish schedule.
Mirrors: FRAMELESS mirrors = included. Framed mirrors, or mirrors by Bobrick (toilet accessory manufacturers generally), = excluded.
scope_boundary_rules.detection_hint: check spec section / accessory schedule for Bobrick or 10 28 00 toilet accessories vs 08 83 00 mirrors

scope_boundary_rules.rule: Glass handrails: ALUMINUM rail systems = pick up entire system (subcontracted out). WELDED STEEL rails = pick up glazing infill only, if any; steel by others.
scope_boundary_rules.detection_hint: rail material callout on details; 05 52 13 (steel) vs 05 73 00 / glazed aluminum railings

scope_boundary_rules.rule: Translucent panels (Kalwall and similar) = ALWAYS included in scope.

growth_strategy: The series table grows three ways: (1) Martin adds entries as he hits them; (2) the spec reader extracts basis-of-design + approved equal series from every job's Division 8 specs and proposes new entries for Martin's confirmation; (3) unknown series encountered on drawings get flagged, never guessed. Long-term this table can be bulk-seeded from manufacturer catalogs — every major manufacturer publishes series/system-type data publicly.
